title: Brick by Frick
author: Blain D.
desc:
Structure:
- Low volume, high intensity 6 day upper/lower split.
- Session length 20-30 min.
- 4 exercises per session.
- 2 working sets per exercise.
- Set 1 RPE 9.
- Set 2 RPE 9.5-10 if safe to do so.
- It’s ok tho leave 1-2 in the tank on squat and deadlift variations, use spotters arms if you can. For safe exercises like leg curls/extensions, raises and arms failure and even beyond is encouraged with partial reps or rest pause sets.
- Double progression- If you hit the top of the rep range on both sets add,
+ 5 lbs to the barbell
+2.5 lbs to the barbell (or reps if limited)
-Deload when main lifts start to stall or every 6 weeks.

Warm up:

Upper 

-5-10 minute cardio to get the HR up and promote blood flow (incline treadmill, bike, row etc…)

-PVC pipe pass throughs (5-10reps)
-PVC pipe pass throughs w/ around the world (5/side)
-PVC lat stretch (20 seconds per side)
-Wall chest opener  (20 seconds per side)
-Supinated band pull apart (10-15 reps)
-Pronated band pull apart (10-15 reps)
-Scapular pull ups  (5-10 reps)

Lower

-5-10 minute cardio to get the HR up and promote blood flow (incline treadmill, bike, row etc…)

-90-90 hip switches (10/side)
-Pigeon stretch (20 sec per side)
-Butterfly stretch (30 sec)
-Standing cross over stretch (20 sec per side)
-Standing quad stretch (20 sec per side)
-Squat stretch ( 30 sec in a deep squat while holding onto something. Also rotate around in all directions with your ankles for improved ankle mobility.)

On exercise 1 only.

- Bar x 8 reps.
- 60% x 4 reps.
- 75% x 2 reps.
- Everything else, straight to working sets. Unless the second exercise has a barbell in your hands. Then do 8 reps with just the bar to make sure everything in that movement feels good.

Rest Times:

- Main lift #1 (2-3 min)
- Secondary lift #2 (1.5 min)
- Supersets # 3&4 (1 min)

Low volume, high intensity, build strength one frick at a time!

ex.note:
On exercise 1 only:
- Bar x 8 reps.
-60% x 4 reps.
-75% x 2 reps.
-Then working sets.

Strict row or Pendlay row.
Feel free to do a few warm up reps with the bar to make sure the movement feels good.

On exercise 1 only:
- Bar x 8 reps.
-60% x 4 reps.
-75% x 2 reps.
-Then working sets.
Feel free to do a few warm up reps with the bar to make sure the movement feels good.
Body weight pull ups or Lat pull downs are fine here too. If you can do 10 BW pull ups though, switch to weighted pull ups.
Seated OHP is fine too if you’re limited by space pressing the bar over head or you just like the extra stability.

No ugly grinders!

On exercise 1 only:
- Bar x 8 reps.
-60% x 4 reps.
-75% x 2 reps.
-Then working sets.
If you have trouble holding the bar in a clean grip, try stretching out wrists and lats for better mobility. Lifting straps work well too for holding the bar if you don’t have the mobility.

ss.note: Take a 30-60 sec break between each leg so that fatigue doesn’t affect your Performance with the other leg.
